title: flagged-rows row
description: One row of `scripts/flagged-rows.py --json`'s `rows` array: every value a spawn needs for one eligible flagged page. Each enum below is bound to the artifact that produces it, named in the property's own description — none is invented here, and none may be widened without changing its producer.

kind.description: Producer: the page's own `page_type:`, else the directory it was found in. Also the sort key — topic 0, goal 1, task 2 — so a consumer opens managers before workers.

vault.description: Producer: the `name` key of a `vault-cli config list` entry.

owner.description: Producer: `docs/fleet-surface.md` § Which manager owns a subject, via `fleet-board.py`'s `manager_on_chain`. Never null — a subject with no manager on its chain gets the fleet sentinel rather than an absent field.

owner_live.description: Producer: `session-liveness.py --list`. Null is 'not asked' — a fleet sentinel has no manager to ask about, and a subject with no live manager is null, not false.

name.description: Producer: the page filename, minus `.md` — the base label a tab is named with, never a derived title.

role.description: Producer: the `# Source` schedule YAML's `frontmatter.role` (via `bborbe/nuke`), else the page's `role:`, else `agent`; normalised to `commands/open.md` § 3.0's three-role table, because a role outside it has no window.

role_source.description: Producer: `resolve_role()` in `scripts/flagged-rows.py` — which rung won. `template` outranks a DISAGREEING on-disk `role:`, which is the Start Day case.

mode.description: Producer: `server/spawn-mode.mjs`'s `SPAWN_MODES` — the only two values a spawn accepts. A page with no `mode:` opens per the fleet's `spawn.mode`, so it is resolved here, never emitted as null or copied raw.

launcher.description: Producer: `resolve_launcher()` — the worker arm's `task` → `worker-default` → `vault`, or the manager arm's `subject` → `manager-default` → `claude-sibling` → `vault`. A row whose launcher cannot be resolved is skipped, never emitted with a null here.

launcher_source.description: Producer: the union of the two arms — `docs/fleet-surface.md` § Spawn a worker item 8 (task, worker-default, vault, override) and § Which launcher a manager opens on (subject, manager-default, claude-sibling, vault). The arms report different sources on purpose.

window.description: Producer: `commands/open.md` § 3.0's role → window table. The role map's fourth key (`Hold`) is not a role target, so it is never a window value.

window_id.description: Producer: the WezTerm role map at `~/.cache/wezterm-role-map.json`, keyed by `window`. Null means the map is absent or carries no entry for that window — the missing-map case the consumer must handle, and the reason `window` is carried separately rather than derived from it.

chip.description: Producer: the same role map's `chip`, defaulting to the agent chip when the map carries no entry. Never null — the role map's own null chip belongs to `Hold`, which is not a window.

session_id.description: Producer: the page's `claude_session_id:`, else `manager_session_id:`. Null is 'this subject has never run'.

liveness.description: Producer: `session-liveness.py --check`'s exit code (LIVENESS_EXIT), plus `none` for a row that carries no session id at all. An unanswerable probe is UNKNOWN, never folded into ABSENT.

branch.description: Producer: `resolve_branch()`'s ordered first-match list — unknown → direct → skip-for-role:manager → open-manager → jump → resume → skip → create. The order IS the partition: an unanswerable probe outranks everything.

pane.description: Producer: `who-needs-me.py`'s `pane_for()`, which PRINTS the pane — never the session registry or the heartbeat store, neither of which carries one. Null when no pane resolves.

blocked_by.description: Producer: the page's `blocked_by:` in either frontmatter shape (inline or list), as the raw entries — the consumer ranks on them, so they are not resolved here.

refused.description: Producer: `resolve_branch()` — the named reasons this row must not be opened as written. Empty is the normal case.
